claim_summaries: An independent-orientation tensor lift with an explicit common-core mismatch register preserves the exact product determinant marginal and avoids the supplied common-cut zero.

A global uniform-proposal Metropolis chain has exact computable rational transitions and detailed balance, but its two-replica spectral gap is 4/binom(2q,q)^2 on directed 2q-cycles, so it does not solve the polynomial-energy gate.
